# Inline Quote for DeepSeek Harness
**Select text. Click Quote. Keep the excerpt in your message.**
为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供行内引用：在聊天中划选文字，点击 **引用**，即可将原文插入输入框，显示为可交互的引用标签（Chip），并与自己的文字混排。
A small Web Client plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Select text in a chat message, click **Quote**, and
insert a native reference chip into the existing composer.
Light mode preview
## Features / 功能

- **Inline quotes / 行内引用：** Insert one or multiple excerpts alongside normal text, in any order.
- *

*Native chips / 原生标签：** Use DSH's existing composer instead of a separate chat or quote panel.
- **P
review / 原文预览：** Click a chip to read or copy the complete excerpt. Code excerpts retain indentation

and line breaks.
- **Edit / 编辑：** Remove a quote from the draft or undo the deletion. Previously se

nt quotes remain read-only.
- **Model context / 模型上下文：** The full quoted text is passed with explici
t `DSH_QUOTE` boundaries, not just the short chip label.
## Install / 安装
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `<profile>` with your DSH profile name. Restart or reload the relevant DSH client if your in
stallation requires it.
## How to use / 使用方法

1. Open a conversation in DSH and select text in a completed message. / 在已完成的聊天消息中划选文字。
2. Click **引

用 / Quote** beside the selection. / 点击浮现的「引用」。
3. Continue typing around the inserted chip; click it
to preview or remove it. / 在引用标签前后继续输入，点击标签查看原文。
## Compatibility & limitations / 兼容性与限制
- Developed and tested against **DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` Web Client**. Other DSH versions have not been ver

ified.
- The current release accepts selections **within one completed chat row**. Selection across
multiple messages and quoting from the **Trajectory / 轨迹** view are not available in the released ve

rsion.
- The plugin uses some internal DSH Client interfaces. An upstream change may require a compa

tibility update.
- Drafts containing quote chips depend on this plugin. **Send or clear those drafts
before uninstalling it.**
## Development / 开发
Source: `client.js` · Changes · Issues · Pull requests.
The next feature being explored is selecting and quoting text from the Trajectory view. See the prot
otype PR; it is **not part of the released version**.
